verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's docs list 'OpenFeature Compatibility: Use Flagsmith with OpenFeature', and its GitHub README says that through its OpenFeature partnership 'you are never locked into one vendor', which directly matches the vendor-neutral flag-code goal. The evidence is only two short first-party mentions, with no detail on providers or usage. missing for 10: which languages have OpenFeature providers, provider setup and feature-parity docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
